visual.method: Chromium (Playwright) at 390 x 844 (phone, touch) and 1440 x 900 (desktop), device pixel ratio 1, reduced motion, UTC. The top of each page is captured (up to 2400 px tall on a phone, 1800 px on desktop) with the moving "shipping daily" ticker masked and the cookie banner hidden, then compared pixel by pixel with the previous run using pixelmatch (colour threshold 0.1). A page counts as changed when more than 0.3% of its pixels differ or its captured height changed. Live numbers on a page (counts, dates) can cause small changes that are not bugs.

weight.method: Bytes transferred over the network (compressed size plus headers, Chrome DevTools Protocol encodedDataLength) for one cold load with the browser cache disabled, waiting for network idle plus 2.5 s so late tags such as analytics are counted. First-party bytes (kolaboro.com) are split by resource type; everything from another host, and code Cloudflare injects under /cdn-cgi/, is counted as third party. Measured from a GitHub Actions runner in the United States.

budgets.note: Budgets in bytes per page type and viewport, set on 5 Nov 2026 from the first measurement (largest page of each type) plus 15%, rounded up to 10 KiB, with a 20 KiB floor (100 KiB for images, because some pages load images only at certain widths). Third-party bytes are mostly the Google tag (about 354 KB per page). Lower a budget when a page gets lighter; never raise one without saying why in the commit.
